Senses.Explanation: To recognize is to identify the person, object, source, or point presented in an encounter. Masters make recognition answerable in public—raising a staff, pointing at a bench, or asking about a seamless stupa—rather than accepting a private claim.

Senses.Note: 7 independently reviewed witnesses delimit this sense.

Senses.Explanation: Vow-power is the efficacy attributed to a deliberately undertaken vow. The records make it a cause of teaching, compassionate return, sustained monastic work, or a bodhisattva’s appearance, while masters can still question how it relates to what has no coming or going.
